title: HSK1 Gate 5 · Qin Dynasty
explanationEn: Gate 5: Qin Dynasty. Read the words below, then read the story out loud. The story is the same one you read on the map — this is the start of it.
explanation: 第5关：秦朝。先读下面的词，再大声读短文。这段短文就是地图上那个故事的开头。
passage: 秦始皇是中国第一个大王。他让中国的字都一样。北边有人常常来，所以他很想做一件事。他要做一个很大的长城。
passageEn: Qin Shi Huang was China's first great king. He made the characters of China all the same. People often came from the north, so he wanted very much to do one thing. He wanted to build a very large Great Wall.

comprehension.questionEn: Read the first sentence again. What does it tell you?
comprehension.question: 再读第一句。它说了什么？
comprehension.answerEn: Qin Shi Huang was China's first great king.
comprehension.answer: 秦始皇是中国第一个大王。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the third sentence again. Who or what is it about?
comprehension.question: 再读第三句。它说的是谁，或者是什么？
comprehension.answerEn: People often came from the north, so he wanted very much to do one thing.
comprehension.answer: 北边有人常常来，所以他很想做一件事。

comprehension.questionEn: Read the whole passage out loud, then say one sentence from memory.
comprehension.question: 大声读一遍短文，再试着背出其中的一句。
comprehension.answerEn: Any one sentence from the passage above.
comprehension.answer: 上面短文里的任何一句。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 大 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“大”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 大 (dà) means "great" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “大”（dà）的意思是“great”，就在上面的短文里。

check.promptEn: In the story, what does 王 mean?
check.prompt: 短文里的“王”是什么意思？
check.explanationEn: 王 (wáng) means "king" — you can find it in the passage above.
check.explanation: “王”（wáng）的意思是“king”，就在上面的短文里。

check.zh: 秦始皇是中国第一个大王。

options.text: Qin Shi Huang was China's first great king.
Long ago, the waters of China were very high.
The water was very big; many people had no home.
